desc: Fruit Helix Jump takes the classic helix adventure and makes it juicy. Drop your colorful ball down the spiral helix tower and smash through layer after layer of fruit, keeping the fall going through the gaps to break juicy fruit slices and score big combos. It is bright, fast, instantly understandable 3D arcade fun — rotate the tower, find the openings, and juice everything on the way down.
